dedupe_keys.name: global urban heat island intensity dataset dynamic equal area method qiquan yang

description: This dataset gives monthly urban heat island intensity for more than 10,000 cities over more than 20 years, in three forms: clear-sky surface, all-sky surface and canopy air temperature. It uses a dynamic equal-area method that finds a rural reference area the same size as the city core while reducing the effect of confounding factors, and draws on eight temperature data sources. The figshare release has a city information table, a 1.4 GB archive of the city-level series and a readme; a 1 km gridded version is also offered through the Earth Engine community catalog and cloud drives. Coverage: over 10,000 cities worldwide. Access: free download from figshare. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: surface and canopy estimates differ in meaning; the readme is a Word file; the gridded copies sit on third-party drives. Simulation uses are city heat island baselines and trends for building cooling demand and outdoor thermal comfort studies, and comparing intensities across cities. Related records: the SEDAC global urban heat island 2013 dataset and the global heat wave exposure due to UHI dataset.
